page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c1.large is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated virtual CPUs and 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. This 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio aligns the instance with compute-optimized hardware configurations.

The ecs.c1.large instance does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. Additionally, the instance has zero GPUs, making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated workloads. There are also zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this server type.

CPU instruction set extensions such as Advanced Vector Extensions, Advanced Matrix Extensions, and hardware-assisted cryptography are not available on this instance type. Hyper-threading is also disabled. Consequently, this server is configured for standard integer-based compute workloads, basic web serving, and lightweight application hosting that do not rely on specialized vector or matrix acceleration.
